schedule.note: Rolling 72 h from anchorDate. A daily trigger at 04:47 ET runs `dmm.mjs due`; only production days do any work. Hard stop 06:45 ET → deliver the best preview + an honest status.

narrator.name: Stack voice
narrator.source: Creator's own saved ElevenLabs voice (category: generated / Voice Design), found by name on 2026-11-14. Never create or clone another voice.
narrator.auth: ELEVENLABS_API_KEY env var; in this cloud environment the network proxy injects the key for api.elevenlabs.io. Never commit keys.

audio.default: Stack voice narration + very subtle SFX + NO background music
audio.music: none. The creator adds music on each platform (TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube).

sfx.max_level: about 30 dB+ below the narration during speech (DMM-003 v03 measured 33.7 dB below); peak at or under -30 dBFS
sfx.gain: fixed: never peak-normalise an SFX-only track

audio.voice: Play the ElevenLabs MP3 untouched on its own track at volume 1.0: no compression, no limiter, no re-generation for audio fixes.
qc: no-music check: the residual (mix minus voice) must be digital silence wherever no SFX is scheduled
speech-to-text on the final mix: every word recognised, no 'music' audio event
voice gain vs original about 0 dB, correlation > 0.99

gate.never: POST READY / auto-publish: the creator approves every episode
